import sys
sys.setrecursionlimit(1000000)

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    s = data[1].strip()
    # counts
    cv = ck = cs = 0
    # freq[i][0] = number of V up to position i (1-indexed)
    freq = [[0, 0, 0]]  # freq[0] = [0,0,0]
    pos = [[], [], []]  # positions for V, K, S (1-indexed)
    for ch in s:
        prev = freq[-1][:]
        freq.append(prev)
        if ch == 'V':
            freq[-1][0] += 1
            cv += 1
            pos[0].append(len(freq)-1)  # current index
        elif ch == 'K':
            freq[-1][1] += 1
            ck += 1
            pos[1].append(len(freq)-1)
        else:
            freq[-1][2] += 1
            cs += 1
            pos[2].append(len(freq)-1)
    # dp[tv][tk][ts][last]  last: 0=V,1=K,2=S
    dp = [[[[-1 for _ in range(3)] for _ in range(cs+1)] for _ in range(ck+1)] for _ in range(cv+1)]

    def dfs(tv, tk, ts, last):
        if tv == cv and tk == ck and ts == cs:
            return 0
        if dp[tv][tk][ts][last] != -1:
            return dp[tv][tk][ts][last]
        INF = 10**9
        ret = INF
        if tv < cv:
            p = pos[0][tv]
            move = max(freq[p][0] - tv, 0) + max(freq[p][1] - tk, 0) + max(freq[p][2] - ts, 0) - 1
            ret = min(ret, dfs(tv+1, tk, ts, 0) + move)
        if tk < ck and last != 0:
            p = pos[1][tk]
            move = max(freq[p][0] - tv, 0) + max(freq[p][1] - tk, 0) + max(freq[p][2] - ts, 0) - 1
            ret = min(ret, dfs(tv, tk+1, ts, 1) + move)
        if ts < cs:
            p = pos[2][ts]
            move = max(freq[p][0] - tv, 0) + max(freq[p][1] - tk, 0) + max(freq[p][2] - ts, 0) - 1
            ret = min(ret, dfs(tv, tk, ts+1, 2) + move)
        dp[tv][tk][ts][last] = ret
        return ret

    ans = dfs(0, 0, 0, 2)
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
